entities.summary: Malmö Stadion, often known simply as Stadion before the construction of the new Stadion between 2007 and 2009, is a soon-to-be demolished multi-purpose stadium in Malmö, Sweden. As of 2015, it is sometimes used by association football club IFK Malmö, presently of Division 2, and athletics club MAI. The stadium served as the home ground for Malmö FF, an association football team in Sweden's top flight, Allsvenskan, from its opening in 1958 until 2009, when the club moved to the newly constructed Stadion, built beside Malmö Stadion, in 2009.
